english: The household can sign in with this phone number straight away. Households cannot create accounts themselves.
kinyarwanda: Urugo ruhita rushobora kwinjira rukoresheje iyi nimero ya telefoni. Ingo ntizishobora kwifungurira konti ubwazo.

english: Change the name, phone number, sector or serial number. The meter number does not change. Every change is in Activity.
kinyarwanda: Hindura izina, nimero ya telefoni, umurenge cyangwa nimero y'uruganda. Nimero ya mubazi ntihinduka. Buri gihinduka kiri mu Bikorwa.

english: The number the household signs in with. Several meters can share one number.
kinyarwanda: Nimero urugo rwinjiriraho. Mubazi nyinshi zishobora gusangira nimero imwe.

english: Printed on the meter by the maker.
What the meter shows today. The first photo is compared with it.
kinyarwanda: Icyo mubazi yerekana uyu munsi. Ifoto ya mbere igereranywa na cyo.

english: WASAC's customer number. Leave empty to make one.
kinyarwanda: Nimero y'umukiriya ya WASAC. Siga ubusa kugira ngo ikorwe.

english: That meter number, serial number or customer number is already registered.
kinyarwanda: Iyo nimero ya mubazi, nimero y'uruganda cyangwa nimero y'umukiriya isanzwe yanditswe.

english: Some details are not right. Check each field and try again.
kinyarwanda: Hari amakuru atari yo. Reba buri gice wongere ugerageze.

english: Added {name} with meter {meter}. They can sign in now.
kinyarwanda: {name} yongeweho na mubazi {meter}. Ashobora kwinjira ubu.

english: Enter the household's name (2 to 120 characters).
Enter a Rwandan mobile number, for example 078 123 4567.
kinyarwanda: Andika nimero ya telefoni yo mu Rwanda, urugero 078 123 4567.

english: Enter the sector, for example Kacyiru.
Enter the meter number: 3 to 30 letters, numbers, - or /.
kinyarwanda: Andika nimero ya mubazi: inyuguti 3 kugeza 30, imibare, - cyangwa /.

english: Meter numbers starting with DEMO- are kept for test households.
kinyarwanda: Nimero za mubazi zitangirwa na DEMO- zigenewe ingo z'igerageza.

english: Enter a reading between 0 and 99999.999 m³.
kinyarwanda: Andika igipimo kiri hagati ya 0 na 99999.999 m³.

english: Use letters, numbers, - or / only, not starting with DEMO-.
kinyarwanda: Koresha inyuguti, imibare, - cyangwa / gusa, bidatangirwa na DEMO-.

english: The same meter is on line {value}.
kinyarwanda: Iyi mubazi iri no ku murongo {value}.

english: The same serial number is on line {value}.
kinyarwanda: Iyi nimero y'uruganda iri no ku murongo {value}.

english: The same customer number is on line {value}.
kinyarwanda: Iyi nimero y'umukiriya iri no ku murongo {value}.

english: This serial number is already on another meter.
kinyarwanda: Iyi nimero y'uruganda isanzwe iri ku yindi mubazi.

english: This meter is registered without a household. Ask an admin.
kinyarwanda: Iyi mubazi yanditswe nta rugo ifite. Baza umuyobozi.

english: This is a test household; an upload cannot change it.
kinyarwanda: Uru ni urugo rw'igerageza; urutonde ntirushobora kuruhindura.

english: This customer number is already registered.
For WASAC's customer list: a CSV file saved from a spreadsheet. You see what will change before anything is saved. A row whose meter is already registered updates that household.
kinyarwanda: Ku rutonde rw'abakiriya ba WASAC: dosiye ya CSV ibitswe ivuye muri spreadsheet. Ubona ibizahinduka mbere y'uko hagira ikibikwa. Umurongo ufite mubazi isanzwe yanditswe uvugurura urwo rugo.

english: Columns: name, phone, meter_number, sector; serial_number, first_reading and customer_number are optional.
kinyarwanda: Inkingi: name, phone, meter_number, sector; serial_number, first_reading na customer_number si ngombwa.

english: {count} rows have mistakes. Fix them in the file, then upload it again. Nothing has been saved.
kinyarwanda: Imirongo {count} ifite amakosa. Yikosore muri dosiye, hanyuma wongere uyohereze. Nta kintu cyabitswe.

english: Saved: {added} added, {updated} updated. They can sign in now.
kinyarwanda: Byabitswe: {added} byongeweho, {updated} byavuguruwe. Bashobora kwinjira ubu.

english: This file could not be read. It needs the columns name, phone, meter_number and sector. Download the sample file to see the format.
kinyarwanda: Iyi dosiye ntiyasomwe. Ikeneye inkingi name, phone, meter_number na sector. Kuramo dosiye y'urugero urebe uko iteye.

english: This file is too large. Upload at most 5,000 households at a time.
kinyarwanda: Iyi dosiye ni nini cyane. Ohereza ingo 5,000 gusa icyarimwe.
